section.name: Upplandsleden, etapp 31, Skokloster-Sånka
section.notes: Final numbered main etapp in the public Upplandsleden set; continues from Etapp 30 at Skokloster and ends at Sånka on the west side of Skohalvön.

drawPolicy: Use Naturkartan Etapp 31 GPX as primary geometry.
No numbered Etapp 32 found in current public sources; do not fabricate onward numbered-stage handoff.
Treat Sånka services as endpoint cluster and keep Skoklosterslingan 31:1 loop features separate.
qa: Computed length 6.696 km is close to the official 6.5 km.
No within-segment simplification step exceeds 500 m.
Start is Skokloster castle/slottspark area; end is Sånka camping area.

importRows.name: Skokloster slott

iterationLog.summary: Compiled first-pass Etapp 31 from Naturkartan route page, Skokloster reserve/castle context, Skokloster camping, Sånka water/toilet objects, Håbo municipal information, independent trail-overview checks and five background agent reports.
iterationLog.sourceReview: Official evidence is strong for Sånka camping/bathing plus seasonal water/toilet. Håberget is strongly described but needs exact coordinate confirmation. No main Etapp 32 appears in current public sources.
nextIterationNeeds: Find exact Håberget hillfort/RAÄ coordinate if available.
Confirm current opening model for Sånka camping food/shop and seasonal facility access.
Decide whether duplicate Skokloster castle/reserve POIs from Etapp 30 should dedupe at integration time.

iterationLog.sourceReview: Primary evidence remains the official Naturkartan/Upplandsstiftelsen route material already cited in this file; no new row was promoted solely from unsourced inference.
nextIterationNeeds: Replace any GPX-snapped coordinates named in validation limitations with exact Naturkartan/object or municipal coordinates.
